screens.title: Welcome to The Flint Focus
paras: Starting this week, all our announcements, updates, and dates live here instead of in the team meeting. A new Flint Focus goes up every Tuesday at 5:00 PM.
Each screen has one quick question to check you've got it. At the end, you'll confirm you've read everything. Please finish by 12:00 PM on Wednesday.

check.q: When should you finish The Flint Focus each week?

screens.title: Our new meeting format
paras: Meetings now run 8:30 to 9:30 PM, and most of that time is spent working at your tables instead of listening to me.

One expectation: side conversations pull everyone off track. If it happens, I'll give one reminder. If it keeps happening, I'll ask you to step out, and we'll set up a 1:1 so you can catch up on what you missed.

check.q: What happens if side conversations keep going after a reminder?
options: Nothing, as long as it's quiet
You'll be asked to step out and set up a 1:1
You'll be moved to a different table

screens.title: For Wednesday
list: Show and Tell, facilitated by Jazera. If you're bringing something in person, don't forget it.
We'll read a short Roompact article together at our tables. Nothing to read ahead of time.
Come ready to talk about what's happening on your floor.

check.q: Who is facilitating the warm-up this week?

screens.title: This week's challenge: Expectations
paras: Talk with three residents about what they expected life in Flint to be like. Where have their expectations been met, and where has it been different?
We'll check in on it at next week's meeting.

check.q: How many residents should you talk with this week?
